items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I still talk to her out in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: Anyway, from there... I was working there, and I had been working... And Billie Holiday came out and joined us; that's where I met her. That's where I started learning how to accompany, by listening to her and... I literally fell in love with her, not sexually, just brother-sister.

I thought that everybody expected a big sexual thing with she and Lester Young when she showed up. But it was not that way. It was brother and sister. Because he had a girl named Teddy, Teddy Bear, and she was there almost every night. I still talk to her out in Los Angeles. She's somebody you should talk to. She could tell you more about Lester Young than anybody. And I can give you her telephone number, Teddy Bear. She's usually stoned, but she makes a lot of sense. But she's a wonderful woman. So when you come…
